## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing the local students and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During afternoon classes, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard, and she refuses to accept Gilbert's apology after school.
>

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) publicly punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for being late by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she refuses to ever return to his school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cool off at home for a while. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future scenario where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her.
>

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the concert and stay overnight at Diana's house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy the performance and return to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) late at night. They run and leap onto the spare-room bed, inadvertently jumping on Diana's sleeping Great-[Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). The next day, after learning that [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious and threatening to cut off Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expresses her remorse to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact a poem on a flat-bottomed boat, but the boat begins to leak, stranding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a bridge pile. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rows by and rescues her, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) angrily refuses his offer of friendship. After returning home safely, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on learning another lesson, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages her not to abandon all her romance.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) should join. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly accepts the opportunity to study to become a teacher. When the class begins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and realizes she has secretly forgiven him.
>

> As the school term comes to an end, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her ongoing rivalry and hidden regret regarding [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach the Queen's class next year, to her students' delight. At home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs away her books for a summer vacation, and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) praises Anne's growth and character during a visit with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> After finishing school and taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results at home. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper to announce that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island), bringing great joy and pride to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress in her east gable room before driving to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a benefit concert with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Despite an initial wave of severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and high-caliber performers, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sees [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience and finds the resolve to deliver a triumphant recitation, earning an encore and praise from the guests.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares to leave for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and shares a heartwarming moment with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) as she tries on a new dress. After arriving in town, she starts her classes and experiences severe homesickness at her boarding house. However, visits from her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates and news about the prestigious Avery scholarship renew her spirit and ambition.

As examination time approaches, the students prepare for the upcoming tests, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflecting philosophically on her efforts and future.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. The household and community mourn, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared sorrow. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her grief with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and reminisces with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about past times and Marilla's youthful romance with John [Blythe](../character/blythe.md).
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that she must give up heavy eye work or face total blindness, putting the future of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in jeopardy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to forfeit her college scholarship, stay at home to care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and take up a local teaching job instead. After learning [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so she could have it, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on her way home and they finally end their feud to become close friends.
>

> On the eve of the school term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses teaching methods and classroom discipline with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), strongly opposing corporal punishment. After returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule by affection rather than the rod. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drinks ginger tea prepared by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before starting her first day of teaching.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for subscriptions, encountering peculiar neighbors like the hyper-neat Mrs. Theodore White and receiving mixed results. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) just had a new baby boy, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) strategically visits him while he is overjoyed, securing a generous five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he flatly refuses.
>

After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home with news that their sick cousin Mary cannot care for the Keith twins, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to persuade [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take them in for the winter.

Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a shocking bright blue due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, news spreads across town. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Oliver gather with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in shared dismay over the disaster.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses town matters with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before returning home to learn from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins must stay until fall. After dealing with Davy's jam-stealing and catechism confusions, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where news breaks about [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) renting his fences for advertisements. The society sends a committee to reason with Judson, but he refuses to change his plans.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks toward the cemetery, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) along the way as he shares thoughts about his parents and rock people. At the graveyard, after tending to the graves of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and they discuss teaching, ideals, and friendship on their walk home.

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency to experience emotional highs and lows, plan how to reimburse [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), and chat about local gossip regarding Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends time with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), sharing tea and discussing his imaginative thoughts and childhood worries. > [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) explains his good behavior before going to sleep. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where they discuss the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's ongoing plans and school updates. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) her list of tasks for the next day.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> A massive hail and thunder storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day predicted in a lighthearted newspaper note, causing severe damage across the village. The family at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) weathered the violent hail inside, after which they learn that Mr. Harrison's parrot was killed. Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss the storm's destruction and note the destruction of an old blighted house.
>

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P49](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0049)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) chat about growing up and upcoming changes as they rest in the orchard. After getting a letter from [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on the bridge, but she gets flustered and cuts the moment short when he touches her hand. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) and talks with him before spending a quiet moment dreaming by the brook.
>

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cheer her up after her spirits are dampened by the townspeople's doubts about her going to college. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) watch them walk off from the window, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stroll through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) and discover a wild apple tree.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) amidst tearful goodbyes and travels by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arriving, she is greeted by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who takes her to their new boardinghouse while chatting gaily to lift her homesick spirits.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their freshman class wins the annual Arts Rush under [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly adopts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them into Redmond's active social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a bundle of letters from home—including updates from [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), Ruby, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md)—which helps connect her old life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to her new life in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for a walk in the park together and admire the autumn foliage and harbour views. On their return route along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) shows them a charming, old-fashioned little house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

> During her second term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects a proposal from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), causing tension between them. Later, [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) writes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) suggesting they rent a house together for the next school year with Stella's [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as housekeeper. Excited by the idea, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go house-hunting around [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) and discover that Patty's Place is available to rent.
>

> After Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) hints at a story competition, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reveals to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she secretly modified and submitted Anne's story 'Averil's Atonement' to a baking powder advertisement contest. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is devastated by the commercial degradation of her work, though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to reassure her about the practical aspect of winning the prize money.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). Before leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces mixed reviews about her published story and adopts a stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), whom they fail to chloroform. Eventually, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperon the household with a relaxed attitude toward their independence.
>

> During a stormy holiday break at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deals with severe winter weather, awkward visits from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Davy's lively chatter. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) delivers the mail, bringing letters from college friends and news that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a thousand dollars.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) chat inside Patty's Place before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) steps outside into the orchard. There, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her and confesses his love, asking her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his proposal, leaving [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) heartbroken and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upset over the loss of their friendship.
>

> During her stay in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her humble birthplace and meets the woman currently living there. The woman allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to explore the house, including the room where she was born, and hands over a small packet of old letters written by Anne's parents. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later visits her parents' grave and reads the letters, feeling for the first time that she truly knows them.
>

[Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) arrives to escort [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the event, where she spots [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Christine across the room and compares herself to her.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their lifelong friendship. After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) accompanies [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and they take a stroll through Lovers' Lane, where they converse about their summer plans and changing lives.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher accepted her sketch, bringing excitement to Patty's Place. While on a walk, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) announces his mother and sisters will visit, unnerving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Roy's family arrives a day early on Friday, creating chaos, but the awkward visit ends with Roy's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) bonding with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>

The next day, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden, where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) confesses his love and proposes. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) happily accepts, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) explains that his past actions were misunderstood while they look forward to their future together.
>

The group enjoys supper together while Captain Jim and [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) share stories and details about the surrounding community and neighbors.

> Captain Jim tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) the romantic history of the schoolmaster [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) and his bride [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md), who lived in their house sixty years ago. He recounts Selwyn's prophetic vision of his bride's arrival after her ship was months overdue. Before taking his leave, Captain Jim welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into the select group of 'kindred spirits' who belong to 'the race that knows [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).'
>

Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) stroll through their garden, taking in the peaceful surroundings of their new home.

> While walking and dancing along the shore after a storm, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is surprised to meet her mysterious neighbor, [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). The two introduce themselves, discuss their lives and mutual acquaintance Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), and agree to become friends despite Leslie's reserved and troubled demeanor. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home and shares her impressions of [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the house of dreams for a pleasant evening of firelight conversation and books. As she leaves, the contrast between their happy life and her own bitterness momentarily saddens her. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) lovingly discuss Leslie's beauty and Anne's hair color.
>

Walking home together afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss Leslie's wasted potential before affectionately reaffirming their own love and home.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), welcoming guests including [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia. While dinner is prepared and served, Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia engage in a lively debate to Gilbert's amusement. After a successful meal carved by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), the party gathers by the hearth as Captain Jim shares stories before taking his leave.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) head to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) to watch the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) come in at the lighthouse with Captain Jim and [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md). After Captain Jim shares stories about his sleeping nephew Joe and plays his fiddle, Marshall and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) dance around the fire. At midnight, Captain Jim opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) and wishes everyone well.
>

Later, when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares news of her expected child, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) acts bitterly at first but eventually gives her a exquisitely handcrafted white baby dress. Inspired after reading Captain Jim's personal life-book, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wishes someone with the right literary gift could write his life story.
>

Captain Jim entertains his guests with numerous sea tales and lends Owen his treasured life-book to read. On the walk home, Owen marvels at the captain's extraordinary life while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assures him the stories are true.

Throughout a wonderful summer at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), Owen works on the manuscript with input from Captain Jim, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), forming close bonds with the group before completing his draft.

[Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) tearfully confesses her love for [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), feeling ashamed and brokenhearted over his departure. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforts her while keeping Owen's secret, and she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) bring [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) back home with them.

After returning from a New Year's visit to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are welcomed home by Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia, who shares news about Owen Ford's book.

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he believes [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) Moore's memory and mental faculties could be restored through a surgical operation. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) strongly opposes the idea, arguing that it would worsen Leslie's suffering and burden her financially. Despite Anne's protests and opposing advice from [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) maintains that it is his duty as a physician to inform [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) of the possibility.
>

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) consult Captain Jim, who surprisingly agrees that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) must be informed about the medical possibility for [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tells [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), who decides to take [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the operation despite the emotional toll. Later, Miss Cornelia angrily confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over the decision, but eventually accepts that nothing can stop the plan.
>

Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) returns home to find [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in shock over a letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). The letter reveals that the man believed to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) is actually his lookalike cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), and that [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) died years ago.

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia visit to admire the child and celebrate his arrival. > Cornelia Elliott discusses the minister's children and their graveyard performance with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Prompted by Cornelia's feedback, Mr. Meredith confronts his children about singing in the churchyard during the prayer meeting. After addressing their thoughtlessness gently, Mr. Meredith mourns his parenting abilities and longs for [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md).

> Jerry decrees punishments for his siblings' cowardice, ordering [Carl](../character/carl.md) to sit alone in the graveyard until midnight. [Carl](../character/carl.md) bravely completes the ordeal in a chilling rainstorm, but comes down with severe pneumonia as a result. After fighting through a dangerous crisis with Dr. Blythe's care, [Carl](../character/carl.md) recovers and is welcomed back by his friends and family.
